items.title: Micron Will “Buy Back a Hundred Billion Dollars” of Stock at Four Times Earnings
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOn CNBC’s Halftime Report, a panelist said Micron will buy back $100 billion of stock, about 13% of its roughly $750 billion market value, at about 4x next year’s earnings. Buying back that much stock at that price lifts earnings per share by about 15%, and it’s still a good deal even if earnings get cut in half.
